title: Spicy Thai Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy dish inspired by the flavors of Thailand, featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together curry paste, fish sauce, soy sauce, honey, and red pepper flakes. Add the chicken pieces and mix until well coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread 4-5 pieces of marinated chicken onto each skewer.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped Thai basil.
Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.
